text:
Maya: Quick sync — we want a compact welcome newsletter + webinar invite for new signups next week. Primary goals: activate product usage, book webinar seats, capture intent. Thoughts on segmentation + send windows? :rocket:

Jon: Love it. My initial segments: `trial-started` (day 0-2), `api-users` (token usage > 0), and `platform-adopters` (invited to pilot). Keep copy lean for trial-started.

Serena: For subject lines, I can test a value-first vs curiosity-first. Examples:
- Value: "Get started: 3 ways to see Redwood speed"
- Curiosity: "How teams cut inference costs by 4x"

Alex K: Send windows: stagger by timezone + warmup cadence. Proposal:
```
- PST: 10:30am
- EST: 11:30am
- CET: 2:00pm
- APAC: 9:30am local (staggered)
- Retry for non-openers at +48h with new subject
```
Keep per-segment throttles to avoid spikes.

Noah: Tracking: please append utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=welcome_q2 and include a hidden query param ?onboard=welcome to tie to funnel. Also add event names: `newsletter.sent`, `newsletter.open`, `newsletter.cta_click`, `webinar.register`.

Maya: Good. Quick ask: do we want a lightweight nurture drip (3 emails) or single invite + reminder?

Jon: Recommend 3 emails: Day 0 welcome (product quickstart + webinar CTA), Day 3 case study + webinar CTA, Day 7 hands-on invite + calendar link. Use the webinar as the conversion anchor.

Serena: For A/B test: split subjects 50/50 on Day 0, and test CTA copy on Day 3 ("Reserve your spot" vs "Save my seat"). Keep lists equal by cohort.

Alex K: Suppress for known customers and users with >5 active org tokens. Also suppress duplicates if they hit webinar register page. Add unsubscribe and email preference center link.

LaunchBot: [automated] Scheduled campaign created in Campaign Manager -> welcome_q2. Draft send preview available: https://tiny.redwood/welcome-plan

Noah: One more: make sure we don't exceed ESP throttle limits; set daily cap 50k and per-minute burst < 1200. Also configure bounce handling + auto-suppression for hard bounces.

Maya: Awesome. I'll draft the plan and share the doc by EOD. Assigning @Serena -> subject lines & copy variants, @Alex K -> send windows & suppression rules, @Noah -> tracking & analytics events. Jon can own the webinar landing/flows.

Jon: On it. I'll put up a quick landing draft and calendar widget today.

Serena: I'll drop 6 subject variants into the sheet and label them A/B.

Alex K: I'll add send window rules and the retry logic to the config doc.

Maya: Thanks team. If anyone spots a risky overlap with other sends tomorrow ping me here. :eyes:
